title: DiffZOO: A Purely Query-Based Black-Box Attack for Red-teaming Text-to-Image Generative Model via Zeroth Order Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety filters (specifically for nudity and violence) in text-to-image models.
